The composition below is internally proved CONDITIONAL on the newly supplied
complete forward-entropy lower theorem for arbitrary stationary finite QMS:

       >=(pi/2) Re Tr[sqrt(rho) H_L(sqrt(rho))],

Here omega=tau_R tensor sigma, sigma>0, tau_R>0, the local positive
Heisenberg generator L need NOT be KMS symmetric, L_* is its Schrodinger
adjoint, and the reference is untouched. The assertion holds on EVERY
faithful joint state and every finite reference. Exact authorized source:

1. First theorem: arbitrary stationary NON-KMS compatible marginals.

Let sigma>0 be a density on finite B=M_d. Let Phi:M_d->M_d be full-domain
CPTP, Phi(sigma)=sigma, and let ONE actual full-domain CPTP broadcaster
mathcal B:B->B tensor B have BOTH marginals Phi on every input matrix.
Do NOT assume KMS symmetry, modular covariance, a real/positive channel
spectrum, primitivity, a gap, or any channel-reference commutation.

There is ONE finite pure sigma-Petz canonical EB map Psi, depending only on
the supplied Phi,sigma (a choice of actual broadcaster may be used to obtain
it), such that simultaneously for EVERY finite untouched R, EVERY density
rho_RB, and EVERY faithful tau_R,

 e_rho^3<=K_stat D(rho||tau_R tensor sigma) b_rho,
 e_rho=T[rho,(id_R tensor Psi)(rho)],
 b_rho=T[rho,(id_R tensor Phi)(rho)],
 T(x,y)=||x-y||_1/2,
 K_stat=9
